items.name: Cirro
items.title: A site for water that feels as considered as the product

sections.label: Challenge
sections.body: Cirro sells packaged drinking water in India. The product already had a point of view — a 7-step purification process, sizes from 250ml to 2L, and certifications people can check. The site did not. A first visit needed to answer one question: what makes this water different, and where do I get it?

sections.label: How we worked
sections.body: I designed and shipped the marketing site end to end. One page, one argument: lead with the product, put proof next, then sizes and a dealer path. Built as a normal site that has to survive on a phone in one hand — not a deck.

sections.label: Outcome
sections.body: Product, proof, sizes, and a path to dealership live in one scroll. Certifications and the purification process sit ahead of the brand story. Four sizes are visible without opening another screen.

quote.text: Tell me what makes this water different before you ask me to buy it.
